name: Implementation Profile: Raster crop
abstract: Extracts the pixels of a raster coverage that fall within a region of interest. `areaOfInterest`'s `schema` $refs `ogc.api.processes.v1.schemas.bbox` directly (OGC API - Processes Part 1 Core's own bbox type), not a bespoke format string.

OTB ExtractROI -- Extracts a region of interest defined by the user
